receipt.result_detail: runtime mechanism over 115 frozen objects; frozen sequential 512-frame trace at each object's native rate/channels; B2/B3-cold/B3-warm/B5 for every object and B4 for the B1-comparable objects; every requested window reproduced exactly on every source; result sha256 a66774555f11bd9506ccfbf1f14e9e4404e6fdc8aa8478518cdee3c705d5ea84

params.content_kind: flagship corpus (frozen before results): runtime mechanism

limitations: this court freezes the runtime mechanism and proves exactness; it reports no comparative timing headline. B2-B5 measurement is the next increment. Measured latency and physical storage-read traffic are recorded as evidence but are deliberately excluded from the frozen static result, which covers the protocol, artifact identities, deterministic counters and the correctness vector

B3 cold/warm states are VERIFIED (posix_fadvise is only an attempt, so mincore confirms residency); when residency cannot be established the state is CACHE_STATE_NOT_CONFIRMED, never assumed. Global drop_caches is never used, and the B3 artifacts live on a block-backed filesystem because fadvise cannot evict tmpfs pages
B4 is a compressed-storage / decoded-resident sampler: the sealed B1 stream is decoded once in full and never modified to gain a seektable
B5 verifies the container once outside the timed path and then reads bounded windows; the reader retains encoded segment state only, never a decoded waveform

protocol.trace: sequential windows [0,512), [512,1024), ... plus a final partial window
protocol.transforms: none: no gain, pan, filter or random seek
protocol.output: exact canonical interleaved i32 into a caller-owned destination
protocol.deadline: computed independently by each source from the native rate
protocol.outside_the_interface: artifact construction (inverse search, FLAC encode, container compile) is authoring/compile work, never a playback operation

sources.B3-cold: raw PCM disk streaming, cold-verified (fadvise + mincore)
sources.B3-warm: raw PCM disk streaming, warm-verified (primed + mincore)
sources.B4: the exact B1 FLAC-5 artifact, one-time full decode -> resident PCM (no seektable)
sources.B5: bounded VOLE materialization over the verified full-object container
